n: DM NVX® 4K60 4:4:4 HDR Network AV Encoder Card (DM-NVX-E30C)
d: DM-NVX-E30C DM NVX® 4K60 4:4:4 HDR Network AV Encoder Card

specs.label: Stream Type
specs.value: Pixel Perfect Processing (default) or DM-NVX-D10/D20/D200 Series

specs.label: Video Resolutions
specs.value: Up to 4096x2160@60Hz (DCI 4K60), 4:4:4 color sampling, HDR10, HDR10+, and Dolby Vision® and Deep Color support

specs.label: Encoding audio formats
specs.value: Multichannel (up to 8-channel LPCM or encoded HBR 7.1 surround sound)

specs.label: Bitrates
specs.value: Fixed: 200 to 950 Mbps - user specified,; Adaptive: Dependent on input resolution of the stream, or; Variable: Less than 150 Mbps to maximum of 750 Mbps, dependent on content and input resolution of the stream

specs.label: Input Signal Types
specs.value: HDMI with HDR10, HDR10+, Dolby Vision, Deep Color, and 4K60 4:4:4 support (Dual-Mode DisplayPort™ interface and DVI compatible)

specs.label: Audio digital formats
specs.value: Dolby Digital®, Dolby Digital EX, Dolby Digital Plus, Dolby TrueHD, Dolby Atmos, DTS®, DTS ES, DTS 96/24, DTS HD High Res, DTS HD Master Audio, DTS:X, LPCM up to 8 channels
